subsystem.name: VehicleAIAndPitOperations
subsystem.responsibility: Pit and AI commentary dispatch, pit-lane and AI-state behavior, and the supporting string/path/standings/UI/archive utilities around them: per-frame pit-zone selection commentary (0x0041B3C0), pit/race status and pit-exit message selection (0x0041BE60, 0x0041C0F0), entrant name lookup in the standings sort buffer (0x0041E890), AI speed-delta flag and shift-pattern display (0x0042ACA0, 0x0042B8D0), path normalization/copy helpers (0x00421930, 0x00421970), title-case string conversion (0x00432650), rigid-body constraint position solve (0x0043E4B0), terrain roughness comparison (0x004624E0), transmission/AI-difficulty and UI render-chain screen setup (0x00471DC0, 0x00476D70), AI overtake gap calculation (0x0047AB35), scene filename base-path matching (0x0047F300), fuel-weight check (0x0049BA50), cockpit LED gauge one-shot init (0x0049CA00), pit-crew animation string mapping (0x004A24D0), and two low-trust wrappers (0x00461550 delegate-call-return-this, 0x00469857 three-call chain).

summary: The packet groups 20 validated functions into four clusters. (1) Pit/AI commentary dispatch: 0x0041B3C0 (pit-zone selection state machine, DERIVED owner) and 0x0041BE60 (pit/race status dispatch) plus 0x0041C0F0 (pit-exit message selection, DERIVED owner) all build 8-DWORD driver-table entries via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion and append them to the session event table at flt_5EA618, guarded by the race-active flag dword_7D0308 and track-condition flt_7CF3C8. (2) AI behavior and setup: 0x0042ACA0 speed-delta flag write at this+0x4550 with a sub_4A46F0 state-transition trigger, 0x0042B8D0 shift-pattern display label rendering, 0x0047AB35 overtake gap calc over a per-AI-car array. (3) Vehicle/terrain/physics: 0x0043E4B0 rigid-body constraint position solve (FPU control-word preservation, rotation transform, wheel-constraint entry reset), 0x004624E0 terrain roughness height comparison, 0x0049BA50 fuel-weight boolean check over dword_7C54E0 floats. (4) String/path/standings/UI/archive utilities: 0x00421930/0x00421970 twin path-normalize-and-copy helpers (merged into one class per no-merge rule, they are structural twins with identical bodies), 0x00432650 in-place title casser, 0x0041E890 entrant lookup by name in the standings buffer, 0x00471DC0 transmission/AI-difficulty screen setup, 0x00476D70 UI render-chain update, 0x0047F300 scene filename base-path match, 0x0049CA00 cockpit LED gauge one-shot init with MAS archive/BMP/texture/animation allocation, 0x004A24D0 pit-crew animation name-to-enum mapper, plus two low-trust wrappers 0x00461550 and 0x00469857 kept as isolated GUESS classes. Most owners are UNKNOWN in the packet; only the pit-zone and pit-exit dispatchers carry DERIVED ownership, and all other classes are GUESS boundaries derived from single functions.

function_roles.role: Per-frame pit-selection commentary state machine: race-active/track/phase guards, requested zone index from clamped a4, projected zone from player-vehicle distance projection, dispatch on state 0 (deactivate zone, event codes 133/135/137 or 126), 2 (activate zone, preceding-event pairs then commit this[v7+316]=2), 3 (generic event 131), 5 (player pit-entry sub-events 123-125), all emitted into session table flt_5EA618.

Pit/race status driver-table message dispatcher: guarded on race-active and track-condition, classifies via sub_4FF130(&unk_8AFEC0) and computes an audio filter parameter via AudioFilterParameterCalculation, then switch-dispatchs on the classification to record/insert messages 506-513 gated by temperature (flt_8AFEF0 > 30.0) and track-grip-average ((flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC) * 0.5 > 0.7).

Pit-exit commentary dispatcher: locates the car slot by driver number (a2+1) in the vehicle array (dword_5F0738, stride 4656), selects audio message id (default 397, range 516-535) from the slot's relationship classification this[v4] (1/2/3), the player's race position and parity thresholds, championship mode dword_7D0410, and an optional random jump-table remap, then emits via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion/InsertDriverTableEntry.

Entrant lookup by name: iterates candidate indices 0..102 in the standings sort buffer dword_7D2DB0, dereferences each node via LinkedListDereference, resolves the per-index entry via ShortComputation_13a0, reads its name pointer at entry offset 0 (fallback byte_5EA438), compares with sub_588410, and returns the matched entry's dword at offset 408, or 0 when exhausted.
Path normalization and copy: normalize trailing backslashes via PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer(a1) then return StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a1); called by ConfigIniParser.

Path normalization and copy (structural twin of 0x00421930 with an identical body): normalize trailing backslashes via PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer(a1) then return StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a1); called by ConfigIniParser.

AI speed-delta setter: for allowed inputs a2 in {0, 1} writes a2 to this+0x4550, and when activating (a2 == 1) calls sub_4A46F0(this, 1, 0) to trigger an AI state transition and returns its result; otherwise returns a2 unchanged.

AI shift-pattern display: BitmaskStateTest gate selects a disallowed-message path ("[base].HOT" + Disallowed text) or a state-cycle path that increments/wraps the index counter *a2, selects a state string by mode/index (upshifts/downshifts/on/high/registered), composes "[base].HOT[state]", renders via TextLineWrappingAndRendering, and returns BrakeBiasSetup's result.

In-place title-case conversion of a NUL-terminated byte string: capitalizes the first char if lowercase, then walks from this[1] and uppercases the current char after a non-letter predecessor or lowercases it after a letter predecessor; returns the trailing NUL byte as a loop artifact.

Rigid-body constraint position solve: saves/restores the FPU control word, converts Euler angles to a 3x3 rotation matrix, transforms body position (this+0x15FC/+0x1604/+0x160C), computes the position error against the supplied pose a2, applies the correction via sub_56F100, clears the constraint-enable flag at this+0xB4, and resets four wheel-constraint entries at this+0x3A8 (stride 1124) with -1 / -1048577; per-frame callee of AIVehiclePathPositionTracking (0x004EF7C0).

Delegate-call-return-this wrapper: calls sub_461560() with no visible arguments and returns the original this pointer; shape is consistent with a constructor forwarding to an initializer, but the role is not confirmed.

Terrain roughness comparison: substitutes the fallback global flt_7D108C for a negative caller threshold, samples the terrain surface buffer behind this+0x0 (byte offset 107456) via TerrainSurfaceRoughnessHeightSampling, and returns whether the threshold is below the absolute sampled height.

Three-call chain wrapper: makes an indirect call through decompiler artifact MEMORY[0x5746985D](), calls GuardedAccessor(v0), and returns FilenameFromLinkedList(v1, v2); v0's origin (ECX) and effective calling convention are uncertain because of a flagged bad stack value.

Transmission/AI-difficulty screen parameter initializer: stores race-mode dword_7D0410 at this+0x324 and the address of the audio race-mode flag global dword_7D1FD8 at this+0x320, fetches the UI list item indexed by the flag, formats it, pushes it into the edit buffer, and returns 0 with no guards.

UI render-chain update for one frame: optionally ticks the engine interface at dword_5EB10C via vtable+12, re-initializes the render buffer flt_5EA618 with 10f defaults, walks a linked-list accessor for an indexed render entry, and when the entry reports a positive element count re-runs the tick and resolves the team-name display entry via TeamNameDisplayIDLookup.

AI overtake gap calculation over an array object a4 (likely per-AI-car state): stores a1 into a4[60], computes a4[64] from a virtual call on a2 minus twice a4[62] minus saved a4[3], and computes a4[69] from virtual calls at byte offsets 36 and 28, with a ConditionalDelegation_6460 gate and negative-gap fallback a3; always returns 0.

Scene filename base-path match: iterates the scene-file array (dword_8AC490, stride 396) for count dword_8AC488, compares each non-empty filename at entry+4 against the base path dword_7CE5D0 (fallback byte_5EA438) via sub_596C80, breaking with the comparison result on a match, else falling back to AIW(0).

Fuel-weight boolean check: when fuel quantity dword_7D0B64 is positive, returns whether the quantity converted to weight (times 0.050000001) exceeds the product of two floats read from the structure pointed to by dword_7C54E0 at byte offsets 14724 and 14732; returns false when not positive. Consumed as a boolean by three callers.

One-shot cockpit dashboard LED-gauge HUD widget init: guarded by the byte init flag at this+0x0; creates five LED sub-elements via sub_49CD80, resolves two control strings and eleven UI-manager handles via sub_548890, builds a cmaps archive path from directory globals, loads three BMP textures at this+0x4/0x8/0xC, allocates animation-control memory at this+0x18/0x1C, sets the init flag, and returns an accumulated success flag.

Pit-crew animation string mapper: normalizes the input string via sub_589901, then runs a chain of strcmp comparisons against pit-crew animation string globals (jack, lollipop, fuel, wheels, 10-second crew roles) returning the matched enum ID in 0-24; returns 0 for the first entry or no match.

classes.name: PitSelectionStateMachine
classes.responsibility: Per-frame pit-zone selection commentary: computes a requested zone index (clamped input) and a projected zone index (player distance projection), and dispatches on an event/state argument to deactivate (state 0), activate (state 2), emit a generic event (state 3), or handle player pit entry (state 5), appending driver-table entries to the session event table flt_5EA618.

classes.name: PitRaceStatusMessageDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Dispatches pit/race status driver-table messages (IDs 506-513) when the race is active and the track-condition state is non-zero, classifying via sub_4FF130 on &unk_8AFEC0 and gating on temperature and track-grip-average globals. Packet owner is UNKNOWN; class boundary is GUESS from the single function.

classes.name: PitExitMessageDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Emits a pit-exit commentary message for the car whose driver number is leaving the pit lane: locates the vehicle slot in the array (dword_5F0738, stride 4656), selects an audio message id (397 default, 516-535 range) from the slot's relationship classification and the player's relative position/parity, with a championship-mode gate and optional random remap, and appends the entry to the session table.

classes.name: StandingsEntrantNameLookup
classes.responsibility: Searches the standings sort buffer (dword_7D2DB0) for the first entry whose name matches the input, resolving each candidate node/index through LinkedListDereference and ShortComputation_13a0 and comparing names with sub_588410, returning the matched entry's value at offset 408 or 0 when the 103-candidate bound is exhausted.

classes.name: PathNormalizingStringCopier
classes.responsibility: Normalizes trailing backslashes on a path string via PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer and returns the copy produced by StringCopyWithBufferRealloc. Two structural twins (0x00421930 and 0x00421970) with identical bodies are merged into this one class.

classes.name: AISpeedDeltaSetter
classes.responsibility: Writes the AI speed-delta flag at this+0x4550 for allowed inputs 0/1 and, when activating, triggers an AI state transition via sub_4A46F0(this, 1, 0). Packet owner UNKNOWN; class boundary GUESS.

classes.name: AIShiftPatternDisplay
classes.responsibility: Renders the AI shift-pattern configuration label: builds "[base].HOT" plus either the Disallowed message or a state string cycled by an index counter, renders via TextLineWrappingAndRendering, and returns a brake-bias setup result. Packet owner UNKNOWN; class boundary GUESS.

classes.name: StringTitleCaser
classes.responsibility: In-place ASCII title-case conversion of a NUL-terminated byte string: capitalizes the first character, then uppercases characters that follow a non-letter and lowercases characters that follow a letter. Packet owner UNKNOWN; class boundary GUESS.

classes.name: RigidBodyConstraintSolver
classes.responsibility: Rigid-body constraint position solve: preserves the FPU control word, converts Euler angles to a 3x3 rotation matrix, transforms the body position, computes the position error against a supplied pose, applies the correction via sub_56F100, clears the constraint-enable flag, and resets four wheel-constraint entries. Packet owner UNKNOWN; class boundary GUESS from the single function.

classes.name: DelegatingInitializerWrapper
classes.responsibility: Thin thiscall wrapper that calls sub_461560() with no visible arguments and returns the original this pointer; shape is consistent with a constructor body forwarding to an initializer, but the role and sub_461560's identity are unconfirmed. Owner UNKNOWN.

classes.name: TerrainHeightComparator
classes.responsibility: Samples the terrain surface roughness height at a grid position through the sampling buffer behind this+0x0 (byte offset 107456) and returns whether the absolute sampled height exceeds a threshold, substituting the fallback global flt_7D108C for a negative caller-supplied threshold. Owner UNKNOWN.

classes.name: SceneFilenameMatchChecker
classes.responsibility: Iterates the scene-file array (dword_8AC490, stride 396) for a held count, compares each non-empty entry filename against a base path (dword_7CE5D0, fallback byte_5EA438) via sub_596C80, returning the match result or the AIW(0) fallback when exhausted. Owner UNKNOWN.

classes.name: TransmissionAIDifficultyScreen
classes.responsibility: Initializes transmission/AI-difficulty screen parameters: stores the race-mode value dword_7D0410 at this+0x324 and the audio race-mode flag address dword_7D1FD8 at this+0x320, fetches and formats the UI list item, pushes it into the edit buffer, and returns 0. Owner UNKNOWN.

classes.name: UIRenderUpdateChain
classes.responsibility: Updates the UI render chain for one frame: optionally ticks the engine interface at dword_5EB10C via a vtable+12 call, re-initializes the render buffer flt_5EA618 with 10f defaults, walks a linked-list accessor for an indexed render entry, and resolves the team-name display entry when the entry reports a positive element count. Owner UNKNOWN.

classes.name: AIOvertakeGapCalculator
classes.responsibility: Calculates an AI overtake gap over an array object a4 (likely per-AI-car state): stores the input into a4[60], computes gap values into a4[64] and a4[69] from virtual calls with threshold fallbacks, always returning 0. Owner UNKNOWN; a4 layout class-specific.

classes.name: FuelWeightChecker
classes.responsibility: Boolean fuel-weight check in the pit subsystem: returns whether the fuel quantity dword_7D0B64 converted to weight exceeds the product of two floats at dword_7C54E0+14724/+14732, returning false when the quantity is not positive. Consumed as a boolean by three callers. Owner UNKNOWN.

classes.name: CockpitDashboardLEDGauge
classes.responsibility: One-shot initialization of the cockpit dashboard LED-gauge HUD widget: guarded by the byte init flag at this+0x0; creates five LED sub-elements, resolves control strings and UI-manager handles, builds a cmaps archive path, loads three BMP textures, allocates animation-control memory, sets the init flag, and returns an accumulated success flag. Owner UNKNOWN.

classes.name: PitCrewAnimationStringMapper
classes.responsibility: Maps a pit-crew animation name string to an integer enum ID in 0-24: normalizes the input via sub_589901, then runs a chain of strcmp comparisons against pit-crew animation string globals (jack, lollipop, fuel, wheels, 10-second crew roles), returning the matched enum value or 0. Owner UNKNOWN.

classes.name: ThreeCallChain
classes.responsibility: Thin wrapper chain: makes an indirect call through a decompiler artifact address, calls GuardedAccessor on the ECX pointer, and returns FilenameFromLinkedList with the original pointer and the accessor result. v0's origin and the calling convention are uncertain due to a flagged bad stack value. Owner UNKNOWN.

state_machines.name: PitSelectionZoneStateMachine
transitions: State0 (deactivate): per-zone flag this[v7+316] must equal 2 and ScoringGateSelector(v7) false -> clear flag to 0; zone index 0 emits 137 (guard v8 != 1), index 1 emits 133 (guard v8 != 2), index 2 emits 135 (guard v8 == 1); zone match v9 emits 126 instead via LABEL_37

State2 (activate): projected zone moved (v8 != v7) or projected distance + 50.0 below requested a4, with per-zone FloatWrapTableInterpolation gate -> BooleanOROfTwoChecks fires the preceding event pair (137/134, 133/136, 135/138), ArraySearchReturningIndex clears the target event, fill matches; commit this[v7+316] = 2
State3: emit generic event 131, reach shared insertion tail
State5 (player pit entry): dword_7C54E8 nonzero and equals a5, sub-type a6: 1 -> fill 123; 2 -> fire 123 then fill 124; 3 -> fire 123 and 124 then fill 125
Shared tail: when LODWORD(v13[0]) != -1 sentinel, InsertDriverTableEntry appends to flt_5EA618

state_machines.name: PitRaceStatusDispatchTable
transitions: Guard dword_7D0308 nonzero and flt_7CF3C8 != 0.0, else return
v0 case 2: v1 != 2 -> default 512; else record 506 then, if flt_8AFEF0 > 30.0, record 507
v0 case 3: v1 in {3, 2} -> 509, else 512; shared grip-average check ((flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC) * 0.5 > 0.7) may record 513
v0 case 4: v1 in {4, 5} -> 510, else default 512
v0 case 5: v1 in {4, 5} -> 511 (grip-average check may then record 513), else 512

interfaces.name: SessionDriverTableEmission
interfaces.purpose: Build and append driver-table (commentary) entries into the session event table at flt_5EA618: StructInitWithSentinelValues initializes the 8-DWORD local entry, DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion fills code/driver/time fields (-1 sentinels, -2.0 defaults), and InsertDriverTableEntry appends it behind the sentinel-guarded tail.

interfaces.name: SessionEventTableQuery
interfaces.purpose: Query/clear/fire event presence in the session table before (re)filling: StateCheckedVirtualDispatch and ArraySearchReturningIndex evaluate whether an event code already exists, and BooleanOROfTwoChecks fires a preceding event pair during zone re-entry.

interfaces.name: ZoneProjectionAndIndexLookup
interfaces.purpose: Compute a projected distance from the player vehicle and map float ranges to zone indices: DistanceProjectionCalc projects the player position, FloatRangeIndexLookup maps the clamped input and the projection to zone indices, FloatWrapTableInterpolation gates per-zone activation, and ScoringGateSelector gates deactivation.

interfaces.name: StandingsListNavigation
interfaces.purpose: Resolve nodes and per-index entries in the standings sort buffer: LinkedListDereference dereferences the dword_7D2DB0 anchor and ShortComputation_13a0 resolves the candidate entry for an index.

interfaces.name: StringPathCopyAndFormat
interfaces.purpose: Copy, normalize and format path/string buffers: PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer normalizes trailing backslashes, StringCopyWithBufferRealloc copies into managed memory, and StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck formats literals into bounded buffers.

interfaces.name: MASArchiveAccess
interfaces.purpose: Open, load from and release MAS archives: sub_53CBC0 opens an archive handle, sub_53CFE0 loads BMP texture resources, sub_53CE40 releases the handle, and sub_53CB20 allocates animation-control memory.

interfaces.name: StringComparisonDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Compare/match strings across the pipeline: sub_588410 compares names for equality in entrant lookup, sub_5884ED feeds the random parity remap gate in pit-exit selection, sub_596C80 matches scene filenames against a base path, and sub_589901 normalizes input before the pit-crew animation enum chain.

interfaces.name: TextLineRendering
interfaces.purpose: Compose and render text lines: BinarySearchInStringTable checks/mirrors a label into the byte_5EC4CC buffer, TextLineWrappingAndRendering wraps and renders the composed line, and BrakeBiasSetup plus ShortComputation_bdf0 run on race/resource globals before returning.

interfaces.name: FPUControlWordPreservation
interfaces.purpose: Capture and restore the FPU control word around float-heavy computation: FPUControlWordMaskExtract captures it and EmptyStub_7780 restores it when the captured mask differs from 512.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionDriverTableAppendContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must preserve the sentinel-guarded append into the session event table at flt_5EA618 via InsertDriverTableEntry, with 8-DWORD entries initialized by StructInitWithSentinelValues and filled by DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion using -1 sentinels and -2.0 default arguments; the first entry field (LODWORD(v13[0]) == -1) gates insertion.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitSelectionZoneEventContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Preserve the per-zone activation flag semantics (this[v7 + 316] cleared on deactivate, set to 2 on activate) and the emitted event codes: 123-125 (player pit-entry sub-events for a6 1/2/3), 126 (zone-matching re-entry), 131 (generic event), 133-138 (zone deactivate/activate codes 137/134, 133/136, 135/138). Event-code semantics are inferred from call signatures and remain unverified.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitExitMessageSelectionContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must locate the pit-exit car slot in the vehicle array (dword_5F0738, stride 4656) by its first dword against driver number a2+1, select the audio message id (default 397, range 516-535) from the slot's relationship classification this[v4] (1/2/3), the player's race position at dword_7C54E8+16480, position-fraction thresholds on dword_5C329C, parity and championship mode dword_7D0410, and apply the random jump-table remap (528->526, 529->527, 531->530, 534->532, 535->533) when RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator returns odd.

compatibility_contracts.name: AISpeedDeltaContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must write the speed-delta flag at this+0x4550 only for inputs 0/1 and, when activating (a2 == 1), trigger the AI state transition via sub_4A46F0(this, 1, 0), returning its result; inputs outside {0, 1} must pass through unchanged.

compatibility_contracts.name: RigidBodyConstraintLayoutContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The constraint-solver object must keep the constraint-enable flag at this+0xB4, the body object pointer at this+0x15F0, the body position doubles at this+0x15FC/+0x1604/+0x160C, and four wheel-constraint entries starting at this+0x3A8 with stride 1124 initialized to -1 / -1048577.

compatibility_contracts.name: CockpitDashboardLEDGaugeLayoutContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The LED-gauge widget object must keep the init flag byte at this+0x0, three BMP texture handles at this+0x4/+0x8/+0xC, the resolved primary/secondary control strings at this+0x10/+0x14, the two animation-control allocations at this+0x18/+0x1C, and eleven UI-manager handles at this+0x20..this+0x48.

compatibility_contracts.name: TransmissionAIDifficultyScreenLayoutContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The transmission/AI-difficulty screen object must keep the race-mode value at this+0x324 and a pointer to the audio race-mode flag global at this+0x320; setup must fetch the UI list item indexed by dword_7D1FD8, format it via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck and push it into the edit buffer via EditBufferStringUpdate.

compatibility_contracts.name: StringTitleCaseContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must perform in-place ASCII title-casing on a NUL-terminated string: uppercase the first character when it is a lowercase letter, then for each subsequent character uppercase it when the previous character is a non-letter (outside 'A'-'Z'/'a'-'z') or lowercase it when the previous character is a letter.
